card.name: Word after 'clinical' in unknown-significance statements
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'significance' (or 'relevance') right after 'The clinical' in sentences saying the finding's meaning is unknown. Also fires on scattered words in label instructions, such as 'compared' and 'if'.

modes.label: Clinical significance
modes.description: The noun after 'The clinical' in a sentence about an abnormal lab or finding with unknown meaning.
modes.example: The clinical<< significance>> of this finding is unknown. Monitor renal

modes.label: Instruction words
modes.description: Single words in label instructions, such as 'compared' or 'if', that come before a condition or a comparison.
modes.example: adalimumab cannot be<< compared>> to rates of lymphoma in clinical trials

card.plain: It lights up on the word that completes 'the clinical significance of this finding', and sometimes on other words in label instructions.
